messages:
Support Tier2: FYI we just got an escalation from BrightHealth — multiple customers seeing incorrect coverage statements in the 'policy_summary' field after the new chat model rollout. They say the model is confidently asserting coverage that doesn't exist.
Customer: Jane Daugherty (BrightHealth): This started ~30m after you said you pushed the new chat model. Example below, this is a live billing convo. Please advise urgently.
Customer: Jane Daugherty (BrightHealth): prompt: 'Summarize member plan coverage for CPT 99213 for patient X.'
Customer: Jane Daugherty (BrightHealth): response: 'Member's plan covers CPT 99213 at 100% after deductible.' (WRONG — actual explanation should note deductible applies, coinsurance 20%).
Support Tier2: Request IDs from customer: req_0a1b2c, req_0a1b2d. Region: us-west-2. Model reported by client: rwd-chat-xl-v2. Rollout note: they say you started a 20% rollout ~6h ago per product notes.
Alex Kim: tagging @Maya and @Eli. Can you grab the request logs and diff token-level output vs rwd-chat-xl-v1? We need repro and quick rollback plan.
Maya Chen: on it. I pulled both responses and compared. The new model has a new decoding heuristic for 'assertive summarization' that increases factualization on short prompts. It appears to prefer a shorter confident phrasing and is dropping hedging about deductibles. Repro steps: use same prompt with system instruction 'Answer as claims auditor' to force carefulness — v1 hedges, v2 does not.
Maya Chen: Repro snippet (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-xl-v2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a policy auditor."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize member plan coverage for CPT 99213 for patient X."}],"max_tokens":200}'
```
Maya Chen: Response from v2: "CPT 99213 is covered at 100% after deductible."
Maya Chen: Response from v1: "CPT 99213 generally requires deductible/coinsurance; coverage depends on plan — recommend checking member's summary."
Eli Rosen: SRE note: traffic split shows 20% to rwd-chat-xl-v2 routed at the edge via rollout-service. There are no errors/500s. Latency normal. This is strictly a behavioral/regression issue.
Jamal Ortiz: Oncall bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT_OPEN id=INC-2026-0433 severity=high — customer-impacting hallucination/regression. Assigned to eng-ml and oncall.
Oncall Bot: Incident channel notified: #incidents. Pager alert sent to oncall rotation.
Alex Kim: Proposed immediate actions (short list): 1) Stop rollout (pause traffic to v2) 2) Route affected customer(s) to v1 explicitly (per-customer route) 3) If pause not instant, enable conservative decoding override (lower temperature, increase beam/penalty) for these tenants 4) Postmortem + revert commit in training infra. Who can run 1-2 now?
Sara Patel: Product: BrightHealth is on a dedicated integration with high SLAs. They need a guaranteed rollback to previous behavior ASAP. We should also open a formal support credit conversation.
Eli Rosen: I can flip the rollout toggle now. Command I'll run:
```
# stop global rollout to rwd-chat-xl-v2
rolloutctl pause --model rwd-chat-xl-v2 --env prod --confirm
# create per-customer route to v1 for BrightHealth
routectl create --tenant brighthealth --model rwd-chat-xl-v1 --priority 100
```
Eli Rosen: ETA ~3m to propagate. Watching logs.
Maya Chen: While Eli pauses, I recommend we also set a safety-decoding override for the tenant: set temperature=0.0, top_p=0.2, and enable ' factuality_high' filter. If we can't change the model, at least lower assertiveness.
Alex Kim: Agreement: Eli do pause and add per-tenant route. Maya implement decoding override and post exact config. Jamal coordinate comms to customer and status updates.
Eli Rosen: Pause executed. Rollout paused at 20% -> 0%. Per-tenant route applied for brighthealth -> rwd-chat-xl-v1. Propagation logs: route-update acknowledged by edge nodes.
Eli Rosen: Observability: seeing ~95% of BrightHealth traffic hitting v1 now, a small tail at proxies for 30s due to caching.
Maya Chen: Decoding override applied for tenant brighthealth: {"temperature":"0.0","top_p":"0.2","presence_penalty":"0.5","factuality_mode":"conservative"} (applied via config service).
Support Tier2: Forwarded update to customer. Customer: Jane Daugherty (BrightHealth): Thanks — initial sanity check looks better. Can you confirm all future requests will not be enrolled in v2 until root cause is fixed?
Alex Kim: We will freeze v2 rollouts for 48h. Immediate next steps for ML: reproduce locally with more prompt variants, write regression tests using customer prompt corpus, and create patch to decoding/labeling pipeline or revert to the v1 decoder defaults. Owner: Maya. ETA for initial root cause analysis: 12 hours.
Maya Chen: I'll run evals on the customer's prompt set across the candidate model variants and propose either a decoder tweak or re-train. Creating evaluation job now.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll own comms. Draft sent to customer: "We've paused the v2 rollout for your tenant and routed you to the verified v1 model. We're investigating root cause and will provide an update within 12 hours. Apologies for the disruption."
Sara Patel: Product requested we log this as an 'output-quality regression' and flag for rollback guarantee for all high-SLA tenants. Also adding billing/sla credit review.
Eli Rosen: Post-incident actions for infra: add faster per-tenant route propagation tests to staging and add canary check for 'assertiveness' metric on rollout (we can compute difference in hedging tokens).
Alex Kim: Good. Quick checklist before we close this thread: - Confirm BrightHealth traffic at 100% on v1 (or acceptable percent) - Confirm decoding override active - Stop further v2 rollouts until ML approves - Create incident ticket INC-2026-0433 on tracker with artifacts and owners - Schedule postmortem meeting within 48h
Eli Rosen: BrightHealth hitting v1: 100% now. Decoding override in place. Rollout frozen. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0433.
Maya Chen: Eval job queued and will post first results to this thread when ready.
Support Tier2: Customer confirmed reduced incorrect assertions. Closing customer-facing conversation; keeping internal incident open until root cause and fix.
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene when Maya posts results. If someone spots other customers showing similar patterns please ping immediately.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE id=INC-2026-0433 status=mitigated note="traffic routed back to v1; tenant override applied"
Maya Chen: (later) First eval run: v2 fails 18/60 prompts on conservative factuality checks; v1 fails 6/60. Detailed diffs attached to the incident ticket. Next: propose decoder revert + small re-finetune.
Alex Kim: Filing follow-up RFC for decoder change and rollout gating. Assign owners and due dates in the ticket.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll draft customer follow-up email and check-in schedule.
Support Tier2: Marking this thread as the canonical incident thread. Will update thread with any customer replies.
Customer: Jane Daugherty (BrightHealth): Thanks for the quick response — appreciate the fast rollback. Please keep us posted.
